recent_items.summary: Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. recent_items.title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual World Modeling

recent_items.summary: Nine years after its introduction, the transformer remains the default sequence model.
